verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API reference (keycloak-docs-6), and the OIDC layers guide lists protocol endpoints (keycloak-docs-74), so a static API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec on keycloak.org all returned 404 (keycloak-probe-3). Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
